news.title: Skyline Ventures India Limited Appoints Kanukollu Janaki Rama Lakshmana Rao as Company Secretary and Compliance Officer, Effective January 20, 2026
news.body: Skyline Ventures India Limited at the meeting held on 20 January 2026 approved the appointment of Mr. Kanukollu Janaki Rama Lakshmana Rao (M.No:A33703) as the Company Secretary and Compliance Officer of the Company with immediate effect. The appointment was made pursuant to Section 203 and all other relevant provisions of Companies Act, 2013 and SEBI Listing Regulations. Mr. Kanukollu Janaki Rama Lakshmana Rao is an accomplished Legal and Compliance Counsel with over 25+ years of expertise in contract law, regulatory compliance, vendor negotiations, and corporate governance. He is specialized in international laws, contract law and gained experience in various cross border assignments. news.title: Skyline Ventures India Limited Announces Reconstitution of Committee, Effective from January 19, 2026
news.body: Skyline Ventures India Limited at its meeting held on January 19, 2026 approved the the reconstitution of the Committees of the Board with effect from January 19, 2026. The Audit Committee shall comprise of Mr. Madhu Mohan Avalur as Member, Non-Executive Director. The Nomination and Remuneration Committee shall comprise Mr. Venkata Satya Subrahmanyam Mukkavalli as Member, Non-Executive Director. The Stakeholders Relationship Committee shall comprise Mr. Venkata Satya Subrahmanyam Mukkavalli as Chairman, Non-Executive Director.

news.title: Skyline Ventures India Limited Announces Resignation of Nikshit Hemendra Shah as Independent Director , Effective December 19, 2025
news.body: Skyline Ventures India Limited announced that Mr. Nikshit Hemendra Shah (DIN: 07910462) has tendered his resignation as Director (Independent) of Skyline Ventures India Limited with effect from December 19, 2025 due to conflicts between management and shareholders. These unwanted conflicts and pressures have impaired smooth functioning of Board in recent times.

news.title: Skyline Ventures India Limited Announces Board Changes
